name: meal-prep-functions
description: Server-side functions for Meal Prep app — Stripe + Supabase + Resend

scripts.check: node scripts/check-ingredients.mjs && node scripts/check-recipe-quality.mjs && node scripts/check-copy-consistency.mjs && node scripts/check-legal-consistency.mjs && node scripts/check-apple-compliance.mjs && node scripts/next-recipe-ids.mjs && node scripts/test-regressions.mjs
